testcase.name: Given app lock disabled and authenticated when onAppBackgrounded then isAuthenticated stays true()
Given unauthenticated when setAuthenticated true then isAuthenticated is true()
Given PIN set when verifyPin correct then returns true()
Given default state when created then isAuthenticated is false()
Given lockout active when isLockedOut then returns true()
Given PIN set when verifyPin wrong then returns false()
Given 5 failed attempts when getRemainingAttempts then returns 0()
Given app lock enabled and authenticated when onAppBackgrounded then isAuthenticated is false()
